Introduction

TWEETY is a four-member girl group under Time Entertainment. They originally debuted as five on May 19, 2015, with their first single "뻔한 소리". Their name is a combination of "trend" and "sweety".

They are presumed to have silently disbanded as their last social media update was in 2021 and their website and Instagram no longer exist.
